parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation; 2007 self-determination ruling and third-gender marker are progressive climate signals. No documented border/document friction, facility bans, police targeting, or trans-specific killing pattern. Traveller-facing exposure is therefore limited: everyday risk is societal — documented discrimination, physical/sexual harassment of visibly trans people in provincial cities (tier 3), plus a rising anti-LGBT political climate (2024 rally; 2026 head-of-government hate speech and supporter death threats) with no clear hate-crime recourse. Conversion therapy and a stripped-identity census episode reflect local-sphere, resident-facing harms. Rule-of-law weakness means thin recourse if a visitor is harassed or outed. Elevated band, near its top.
